adapters.name: tailscale
adapters.description: This machine's tailnet, read through the tailscale CLI already installed and logged in here. No credential is declared or needed: the CLI's own session is the authentication, which is the point of the adapter route for this request (#1936).

tools.name: listTailnet
tools.description: The tailnet from tailscale status --json: the CurrentTailnet block (name, MagicDNS suffix), this machine's own node, and every peer node with its addresses and online state.

tools.name: listHostnames
tools.description: The hostnames on the tailnet from tailscale status --json: this machine's HostName and DNSName, and every peer's HostName and DNSName.
